title: Implement approver eligibility and exact-proposal invalidation
verify: Boss eligibility works only after Safety Gate clearance for Farm Plants.
Engineer eligibility requires active PlantAccessGrant with plant_approve_actions for the exact Plant.
Consultant, disabled account, disabled/removed membership, revoked grant, archived Plant, stale evidence, changed proposal wording/parameters, and expired ActorContext are ineligible.
Eligibility is exact-proposal scoped and cannot be replayed after scope, evidence, grant, actor, wording, or parameter changes.
evidence_required: negative tests for Consultant, revoked grant, archived Plant, stale evidence, and changed proposal
constraints: Consultant is never eligible for physical-action approval in MVP.
plant_approve_actions is the only MVP per-Plant approval override.
The model, Companion, AgentMemoryRecord, UI Feed, and DecisionRecord cannot approve or make an actor eligible.
invariants: Every approval eligibility path resolves fresh ActorContext and PlantAccessGrant.
Governance DecisionRecord cannot substitute for Safety Gate approval.
Approval scope is exact proposal only.
verification_targets: Boss eligibility after Safety Gate clearance
revoked PlantAccessGrant and archived Plant denial
